claims.text: Defense Intelligence Reference Document titled "MHD Air Breathing Propulsion and Power for Aerospace Applications", series "Defense Futures", published 2010-11-21 with an Intelligence Cut-Off Date (ICOD) of 2010-07-20, DIA document number DIA-08-1011-006. Released by DIA under FOIA and posted in the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.

Inside cover reads: "This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted b(3) 10 USC 424] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program" and directs questions to the "AAWSA Program Manager, Defense Intelligence Agency, ATTN: [redacted], Bldg 6000, Washington, DC 20340-5100".

Author name is withheld in the DIA-released copy under FOIA exemption (b)(6); the "Prepared by:" line is withheld under (b)(3) 10 USC 424. The released cover therefore does not attribute the DIRD to a named author.

Cover page reads: '21 November 2010 / ICOD: 20 July 2010 / DIA-08-1011-006 / Defense Intelligence Reference Document / Defense Futures / MHD Air Breathing Propulsion and Power for Aerospace Applications'.

Attributed on the DIA list of AATIP/AAWSAP products supplied to the Senate Armed Services Committee to 'Dr S Macheret, Lockheed Martin', where the title is given in full as 'Magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) Air Breathing Propulsion and Power for Aerospace Applications'.
Also held in the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room as a 32-page released document.

connections.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)
connections.note: The released document names the programme itself. Its inside cover reads 'This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency ... Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program' - the redaction between them is (b)(3):10 USC 424. Verified by downloading this DIRD and scanning its full text on 23 August 2026. The scans are OCR-degraded, so the quotation is normalised from the damaged rendering.

connections.label: Sergey O. Macheret
connections.note: The DIA congressional list credits 'Magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) Air Breathing Propulsion and Power for Aerospace Applications' to 'Dr S Macheret, Lockheed Martin'. Macheret is a plasma physicist (Ph.D., Kurchatov Institute) with a substantial peer-reviewed record in MHD flow control, and this DIRD is among the most conventionally grounded on the list.
